sentences.en: "I can't even make a crane," she said to herself.
sentences.zh: 她自言自语道：‘我甚至做不出一只纸鹤。’

sentences.en: People in the back row craned to see the stage.
sentences.zh: 后排的人伸长脖子看舞台。

sentences.en: Of course, a license is needed to operate a crane.
sentences.zh: 当然，操作起重机需要执照。

senses.zh: 用起重机起吊；伸长脖子
